import sys
from yt_dlp.webvtt import Magic, _MatchParser

WEBVTT_INPUT = (
    "WEBVTT - sample\n"
    "Kind: captions\n"
    "Language: en\n"
    "\n"
)

calls=[]

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'call' and frame.f_code.co_filename.endswith('yt_dlp/webvtt.py'):
        calls.append((frame.f_code.co_name, frame.f_code.co_firstlineno))
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
parser = _MatchParser(WEBVTT_INPUT)
block = Magic.parse(parser)
sys.settrace(None)

for i,(name,line) in enumerate(calls,1):
    print(f"{i:02d} {name} {line}")
print('COUNT', len(calls))
PY
